headline: FDI inflows to Mexico rise 5.3% through September, to a record US$43,090 million
summary: Foreign direct investment into Mexico rose 5.3% year on year to a record $43.09 billion from January to September 2026, the Economy Secretariat reported.
why: Foreign direct investment shows how much long-term capital multinationals commit to a country, and it is a key indicator for Mexico's manufacturing and nearshoring prospects.
original_headline: Llegadas de IED a México suben 5.3% a septiembre, hasta récord de 43,090 millones de dólares
